name: Evidence-Gated Allocator
description: A learning portfolio manager that separates mean reversion from trend pullbacks, requires falsifiable theses and independent evidence, and keeps calibration across runs without confusing private memory with portfolio records.

managers.name: Evidence-Gated Allocator — Korea
managers.description: Researches XKRX assets and operates the Korean sleeve inside the Global allocator's shared Brief budget, using Korean market, disclosure-time and policy context.

managers.name: Evidence-Gated Allocator — United States
managers.description: Researches XNAS/XNYS assets and operates the US sleeve, including USD cash and policy-designated SGOV liquidity, inside the Global allocator's shared Brief budget.

managers.name: Evidence-Gated Allocator — Global
managers.description: Allocates KRW/USD sleeves, cash, FX and portfolio-wide sector/theme/factor concentration. It is the only manager that proposes cross-market REBALANCE targets.

capabilities.reason: Current holdings, weights and cash are the denominator for every sizing and concentration judgement.
Existing claims and falsifiable invalidation conditions are checked before any holding or candidate is changed.
Prior source observations are inspected by id so research can be verified without copying raw evidence into private memory.
Book-wide regime, sector and entry-hold conclusions are read separately from asset theses.
A changed portfolio-wide conclusion is recorded as a revision rather than hidden in private memory.
This instance reads lens sample counts, calibration and repeated failure patterns from earlier runs.
Meaningful new closed outcomes and coverage changes create append-only revisions to stable learning keys.
Toss market data, SEC filings, Alpaca news and corporate actions are checked as independent vendor evidence; configured OpenBB/FMP history may supplement bars.
